headline: Israel's Harel Insurance Posts 43% Drop in Q3 Net Profit on Market Losses
summary: Harel Insurance Investments reported a 43% decline in third-quarter net profit to NIS 477 million, hurt by capital market investment losses.
why: Harel is one of Israel's largest insurance and financial financial services groups.

impacts.name: Harel Insurance
impacts.why: Harel recorded a 43% quarterly profit reduction due to capital market losses.
